open_obligations: Note that Wen et al. do not train a policy through multiple RRM levels.
Check the AI-AI result that direct critique beats recursive self-critique when the critic is stronger.
Check whether task difficulty is comparable to code review.
in.other_title: Recursive self-critiquing: critique of critique is easier than critique, recursively
in.rationale: McAleese et al. call critique only the first step of recursive reward modeling and ask whether critique can be used effectively for further steps. Wen et al. hypothesise and test that critiquing a critique is easier than critiquing, recursively, across Human-Human, Human-AI and AI-AI experiments; they evaluate supervision accuracy and Best-of-N reward models, not full RRM training of policies.
in.scope: proposed ADDRESSES: whether critique can support further recursive oversight steps, via critiques of critiques
